1. **Exact phase-only obstruction.** Every Hamiltonian generated by `XX+YY`, `ZI`, `IZ` and a scalar identity preserves excitation number. Split its propagator into the even block on `00,11` and the odd block on `01,10`. Each allowed generator satisfies

   \[
   \operatorname{tr}H_{\rm even}=\operatorname{tr}H_{\rm odd}.
   \]

   Therefore every time-ordered sequence, including simultaneous or arbitrarily interleaved phase controls, obeys

   \[
   \boxed{\det U_{\rm even}=\det U_{\rm odd}.}
   \]

   This follows directly from the determinant evolution equation and is preserved by multiplication. Local occupation phases `exp(i alpha n_L)` and `exp(i beta n_R)`, rather than traceless Pauli rotations, obey the same relation. Global phase multiplies both determinants by the same factor.

   CZ instead has even determinant `-1` and odd determinant `+1`. It violates the invariant, including after any global phase. Arbitrarily long sequences cannot overcome it; the invariant also excludes arbitrarily accurate approximation to CZ by this closed effective control group. A faster entangling operator is available: `E(pi/2)` is inverse iSWAP and `E(pi/4)|10>` is maximally entangled. These are different gate targets.

2. **Explicit CZ with arbitrary local gates.** Write `X_L=X tensor I`, let `H` be the Hadamard, and `S=diag(1,i)`. Since `XX` and `YY` commute and conjugation by `X_L` reverses `YY`,

   \[
   X_L E(\pi/4)X_L E(\pi/4)=e^{-i\pi XX/4}.
   \]

   An exact identity, including the global phase, is

   \[
   \boxed{\mathrm{CZ}=e^{i\pi/4}(S^\dagger\!\otimes S^\dagger)
   (H\!\otimes H)X_LE(\pi/4)X_LE(\pi/4)(H\!\otimes H).}
   \]

   Operations act from right to left. This requires two exchange intervals of duration `pi/(4 J_g)` each. All adjacent local operations can be combined, leaving three local layers: an input layer, one intervening `X_L`, and an output layer. Conjugating the result by `I tensor H` gives CNOT.

   The total exchange time is

   \[
   \boxed{T_{\rm ex}=\frac{\pi}{2J_g}
   =\frac{4\pi}{g^2}[1+O(g^2)].}
   \]

   The source protocol's time `12 pi/g^4` is asymptotically `3/g^2` times this exchange duration. Wall-clock cost is `T_ex + T_local` when the interaction can be suspended during the local layers. source_excerpts.text:
## Exact phase-only reachable group

Use the computational order `00,01,10,11`, Pauli matrices `X,Y,Z`, and independent ideal controls

\[
H(t)=J(t)(XX+YY)+a(t)ZI+b(t)IZ.
\]

Arbitrary real strengths, nonnegative durations, and independent pulse timing are admitted. Write

\[
A=XX+YY,\quad C=YX-XY,\quad D=ZI-IZ,\quad S=ZI+IZ.
\]

On the one-excitation subspace `01,10`, these act as `2X,2Y,2Z,0`. On `00,11`, only `S` acts, as `2Z`. Thus the exact reachable group is

\[
\boxed{G=\left\{
\begin{pmatrix}
e^{-i\phi}&0&0&0\\
0&u&v&0\\
0&-v^*&u^*&0\\
0&0&0&e^{i\phi}
\end{pmatrix}:\ \phi\in\mathbb R,\ |u|^2+|v|^2=1\right\}.}
\]

Necessity follows by block restriction of the time-dependent Hamiltonian: the middle block is traceless Hermitian, and the two outer energies are opposite. Sufficiency follows because `D` and `A` implement arbitrary `Z-X-Z` Euler rotations in the middle block, while `S` independently supplies any outer phase. Equivalently the Hermitian Lie algebra is exactly `span_R{S,D,A,C}`: `S` is central, `[D,A]=4iC`, `[A,C]=4iD`, and `[C,D]=4iA`. No commutator produces `ZZ`.

If physical occupation controls `n_L=(I-ZI)/2,n_R=(I-IZ)/2` replace traceless Pauli controls, the exact vacuum-fixed group is

\[
G_n=\{\operatorname{diag}(1,V,\det V):V\in U(2)\}.
\]

This differs from `G` only by the permitted global-phase convention. Both satisfy the stronger-than-number-conservation invariant

\[
\boxed{\det U_{\rm even}=\det U_{\rm odd},\qquad
U_{\rm even}=U|_{00,11},\quad U_{\rm odd}=U|_{01,10}.}
\]

The equality is preserved under all compositions and limits, and under an overall phase because both blocks have dimension two. For `CZ=diag(1,1,1,-1)`, the even determinant is `-1` and the odd determinant is `+1`. Hence neither CZ nor any global-phase multiple is reachable. The closed invariant also rules out arbitrarily accurate approximation by exchange-plus-phase sequences. The mere fact that iSWAP is entangling does not remove this obstruction.

## Accepted mathematical scope

Both workers independently derive that exchange `XX+YY` plus local `ZI,IZ` preserves equality of the two parity-block determinants. CZ violates that closed invariant, even up to global phase. Thus ideal exchange plus phase controls cannot synthesize or arbitrarily approximate this same two-qubit target.

Both also construct an exact CZ once transverse local gates are supplied. In the normalization `H_ex=J(XX+YY)/2`, two partial exchange intervals total `pi/(2|J|)`. With the source's `J_g=g^2/8+O(g^4)`, exchange time is `4pi/g^2[1+O(g^2)]`. The construction worker additionally supplies an ideal zero-duration-local-control optimality argument; no hardware time optimum follows.

The coordinator read both complete arguments and scripts, then replayed unchanged script copies in separate reviewer directories: all **13 audit checks and 12 construction checks pass**. Original worker outputs remain unchanged. This completed internal mathematical review accepts the stated finite-dimensional control conclusions. It does not audit the producer's infinite-volume spectral theorem, acquire physical pulses, or prove a lower bound for the full SSH Hamiltonian. The proposed fourth-order interaction lies outside the exchange-only model.

## Existing knowledge and physical relevance

The determinant distinction is established matchgate theory, not a new Astra theorem: [Jozsa and Miyake](https://arxiv.org/html/0804.4050v2). [Brod and Galvão](https://arxiv.org/html/1106.1863v1) explain related parity-preserving resources with further circuit assumptions; no many-qubit universality claim is inferred for this device.

Absence from a model is not absence from plausible hardware. The relevant [Kim et al. experimental SSH waveguide](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevX.11.011015) has individual excitation-drive and flux-control lines. That makes broader controls a substantive comparator to investigate, not a capability to assume impossible. It does not establish the controls, error budget or gradient-port geometry of Astra's exact model. Existing [hard-core Green-function machinery](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.6.043264) also remains prior art; no model-specific priority was established here.
